findings.claim: Persistent slow frames also occur with no texture/geometry preparation, no bosses and low HUD/world update cost. The 125.2s texture event is a separate transient submission spike, not a complete explanation of sustained 40–45FPS.

Recent three patches do not alter FrameLoop or the SDK RAF/maxFPS cap. At a 60 target, ideal 60/90/120Hz monotonic RAF feeds accept about 600 renders in 10s; no intrinsic 40/45 cap or duplicate loop was found.

activeMeshesMs brackets native _evaluateActiveMeshes candidate scan/readiness/world matrix/LOD/frustum/activation/submesh classification. It is CPU work, not a GPU time. There are no application before/after-active-evaluation observable subscribers in baseline source.

drawSubmissionMs is the pinned SDK renderTimeCounter, refreshed again on onAfterRender; draw/shadow/after-draw callback work can overlap. It cannot isolate upload, shader compilation, driver wait or GPU execution.

New diagnostic PerfCounter callbacks are bounded scalar observers; enabling same scene does not stack them and disable removes them. Unsupported GPU path does not issue query/GL polling. Local Node timing is not a phone speed bound.

Diagnostic endFrame itself runs after the recorded work timestamp, so its summary/DOM cost can affect the next interval but is not in jsSubmitMs. Browser layout/compositing/GPU/temperature cannot be excluded by this CPU-only audit.

scenarios: Each of village, plains, forest, cave: identical saved camera/position, quality high, 60FPS target, resolution1664x768, same LOD and plains240%; wait geometry/texture pending0 and observe 15s idle + 15s orbit + 15s movement, diagnostics off/on separately. Do not compare phone thermal state across unmatched runs.

Cold texture promotion separately: approach village at z37.9→30.1, record current-work spike and next interval independently; compare first promotion and fully resident replay with unchanged texture URL/dimensions.

Traverse village→plains→forest→cave→forest→plains→village twice; native LOD near/mid/far/frustum, tier outlines, open chest state, cave fog/material isolation and health/equipment remain unchanged; diagnostic observers/render loops plateau.

Pause using settings/HUD editor/minimap, background/pagehide, foreground/pageshow/context restore: active render callbacks0 while paused/hidden, one after resume; timer queries cancelled and stale GPU samples not reported as live.

Any active-candidate optimization must compare actual production visible mesh/instance/submesh IDs plus LOD and shadow eligibility at boundary cameras and all four maps; counters alone do not prove equal imagery.
